title: I edited a migration that had already run, and bricked launch
I windowed an IMAP sync query by date and deleted months of Archive
I designed machinery to reconstruct an address the server already told us
I treated "I could not determine the answer" as "the provider said it's done"
I ran `xcodegen generate` and silently killed smart push
I reported a test count from a bundle that never rebuilt
I read the first `create(table:)` as the effective schema, after a later migration had replaced it
I verified that a recovery path exists, without asking where that path is itself blocked
I amended a hash-pinned Companion fragment in place, and the verifier died on line one
I designed a bulk write whose WHERE clause selected exactly the rows a guard was protecting
I declared a residual acceptable on a safety argument I never actually ran
I guarded a reader on a caller census whose grep shape hid half the callers
I asked a question about bytes another system parses, using a String API that groups them for human reading
I wrote a red-first proof that could not run red — the inverted build trapped instead of failing
